proposals.name: Add
proposals.reason: The material-introduction component matches Add. Preserve stated quantities and catalyst-solution identity; unresolved vessels, quantities, and the [Reactants] placeholder must not be invented. Reflux in the last observation is a separate effect.

proposals.name: Atmosphere
proposals.reason: Under N2 matches the existing context-only environment mode. It does not establish a purge or evacuation/refill procedure; vessel identity remains unresolved.

proposals.name: Evaporate
proposals.reason: Concentrating the filtrate to a crude oil matches volatile-inventory removal. Preserve the reported oil endpoint without inferring pressure, temperature, duration, or rotary hardware.

proposals.name: Filter
proposals.reason: Filtering matches Filter. The quoted fragment alone does not resolve keep, vessel, medium, or driving method; the supplied operation label does not fill those requirements.

proposals.name: Purify
proposals.reason: Normal-phase column chromatography is already covered by Purify with the stated method. No new purification operation is needed.

proposals.name: Separate
proposals.reason: Partitioning aqueous and organic layers matches Separate, but the retained phase and vessel are unresolved. Do not infer which phase contains product.

proposals.name: Stir
proposals.reason: The explicit stirring components match Stir: 120 seconds in the first observation and 1800 seconds in the other two. Preserve room-temperature context or the stated 150 °C condition separately; microwave heating is not represented by Stir.

proposals.name: MicrowaveHeat
proposals.reason: These phrases describe microwave heating at 150 °C for 1800 seconds. HeatChill lacks the microwave hardware mode, and Irradiate explicitly describes optical energy, so neither is a lossless representation. The supplied Irradiate label is not evidence of optical irradiation.

guards: microwave-compatible configuration must be established before execution
contract.note: Explicit stirring remains a separate concurrent condition. No executable mapping is established.

proposals.name: HeatToReflux
proposals.reason: Reflux specifies a boiling-and-condensation regime, not merely a numeric temperature. HeatChill has no reflux endpoint or mode, and the source supplies no temperature; an Add-plus-HeatChill macro would lose this condition.

contract.note: The preceding catalyst-solution addition remains separate. No executable mapping is established.

proposals.name: AddDropwise
proposals.reason: Add covers material introduction but does not explicitly preserve discrete dropwise delivery and a total dosing interval. A numeric rate cannot be derived without an amount, and adding Wait would not preserve dosing concurrency.

proposals.name: AdjustPH
proposals.reason: The endpoint pH >10 is not expressible by a fixed quantified Add alone. Reagent, dose, measurement, and endpoint-control details are absent, preventing a lossless known-operation macro.

proposals.name: VacuumDry
proposals.reason: Drying a reagent mixture under high vacuum is distinct from concentrating a liquid by Evaporate and from establishing a gas atmosphere. The registry lacks a drying contract preserving material role and vacuum mode.

contract.note: Do not infer a numeric pressure or removal of any particular constituent. No executable mapping is established.

proposals.name: AdsorbOntoSupport
proposals.reason: Adsorption onto silica gel changes the material's association with a support. Add alone does not preserve that effect, and Purify would conflate sample preparation with terminal separation.

proposals.name: PlaceVesselsInBlock
proposals.reason: The quotation describes positioning intact vials in a reaction block, not moving material between vessels. Transfer would incorrectly introduce a material-location change across vessel boundaries.

proposals.name: 96-well sample dilution plate
proposals.reason: This is an existing well_plate family member, not a new apparatus type. Preserve the stated 96 wells; the 400 µL scope is not a per-well capacity or allocation. Family membership does not establish interchangeability.

proposals.name: Round-bottom flask
proposals.reason: The quotation explicitly identifies a 500 mL round-bottom flask, matching the existing family. Preserve that stated volume without assigning a registry profile, material, pressure rating, or interchangeability.

proposals.name: Magnetic stir bar
proposals.reason: The explicitly present stir bar is distinct from a hotplate_stirrer and does not prove that stirring occurred. No existing family represents this accessory; size, material, and interchangeability remain unknown.

proposals.name: Reaction tube
proposals.reason: The source identifies a dried Radley tube, not a drying procedure or a specified vial profile. Retain the source designation without inferring manufacturer, model, material, capacity, or pressure rating; this is a candidate apparatus family.

proposals.name: LC-MS analytical system
proposals.reason: LCMS, LC-MS, and LC/MS denote the same common analytical system type here. No existing apparatus family covers it. Grouping does not equate instrument configurations or establish interchangeability, methods, or models.

proposals.name: GC-MS analytical system
proposals.reason: GC/MS identifies a gas-chromatography–mass-spectrometry system, distinct from LC-MS. No existing apparatus family represents it; configuration and identity remain unspecified.

proposals.name: NMR analytical instrument
proposals.reason: The 1H NMR mention supports an analytical apparatus type absent from the registry, but not a specific instrument, field strength, probe, or acquisition configuration. Family classification is not interchangeability evidence.

proposals.name: HPLC column
proposals.reason: A chromatographic column is neither a filter nor the complete HPLC apparatus. Retain the quoted Kromasil C8 designation, 10 µm particle size, and 250 × 20 mm ID dimensions without inferring a manufacturer or further specifications. This is a candidate family, not an interchangeable-device assertion.

proposals.name: HPLC separation system
proposals.reason: The observation supports an HPLC separation apparatus type absent from the registry. Keep the system distinct from its column and pump; no column, configuration, model, or interchangeable profile is established.

proposals.name: HPLC liquid-delivery component
proposals.reason: The reported component fits the existing pump family's liquid-moving role, but the quotation directly establishes only an HPLC flow of 19 mL/min. Treat the hardware classification as provisional; do not identify a syringe pump, model, capacity, or interchangeable profile.

proposals.name: Parallel-synthesis reaction block
proposals.reason: The quotation explicitly names a 96-position reaction block. A heating_block classification would infer heating capability not stated here. Retain the quoted apparatus designation without adding specifications or claiming interchangeability.
